objective: DESIGN LANE. Convert open ICPERF ideas into hypothesis and experiment contracts, disjoint from BATCH-a33cda (the point-decomposition instrument repair). AGENTS.md ECC instruction 3 makes an open ECC idea ranked work to be designed, not shelved: tools/ecc_priority.py --open-ideas lists 8 open ICPERF ideas and DEC-20260916-3c0cf5 ranks all 8, designs the top 3, approves the one whose protocol is complete and whose inputs exist, and records enumerated approval preconditions plus one impediment for the other two. This lane launches NO trial and writes no experiment implementation code. Designing is not approving; approving is not dispatching.
max_concurrent_basis: Machine headroom and archive isolation, not a research budget. The only task in this queue is an archival commit, and AGENTS.md requires commit tasks to run ALONE in the worktree. GOAL-ICPERF-e6b6a4's campaign_budget.max_concurrent is 2 and BATCH-a33cda holds the other slot; this lane takes one. Unlike that lane, nothing here is a timing measurement, so this lane does not require and does not compete for a quiet host -- every primary metric in all three contracts designed here is a load-invariant count.

notes.text: This queue IS the batch record; there is no batch.yaml, matching BATCH-51e2aa and BATCH-a33cda in this goal, which also have none. The opening and operative decision is DEC-20260916-3c0cf5 and it carries the full ranking of all eight open ICPERF ideas, the selection of three, the pairing of pre-allocated identifiers to ranks, the approval of one contract, and the recorded impediment IMP-1. No separate opening-report.md is written: the decision record is the human-readable account and duplicating it would create a second copy of a ranking that must not drift.

DISJOINT FROM BATCH-a33cda ON THREE AXES, DELIBERATELY. (1) WRITE SCOPE: no task here reads or writes ledger/goals/GOAL-ICPERF-e6b6a4/goal.yaml, coordination/goals/GOAL-ICPERF-e6b6a4/batches/BATCH-a33cda/, coordination/review/icperf-20260915-a33cda/, experiments/EXP-ICPERF-e21835/, experiments/EXP-ICPERF-13f001/ or experiments/EXP-ICPERF-66fd51/. This lane's state lives in ledger/goals/GOAL-ICPERF-e6b6a4/checkpoints/BATCH-94168f.yaml, a write-once shard, and in the already-committed lane file. (2) SOFTWARE: none of the three contracts designed here uses a Groebner engine, so none depends on the instrument under repair; EXP-ICPERF-2f2e40's exhaustive table IS the UNSAT certificate the Groebner column would have supplied. (3) MACHINE HEADROOM: every primary metric designed here is a count (table entries, root classes, agreement counts, WDSat conflicts and decisions), and counts are invariant under load, so no contract here needs the quiet host BATCH-a33cda's timing benchmarks require. The stated cost of (3): these contracts contribute nothing to the seconds-valued columns of RQ-ICPERF-94c86e, which stay owed to batches that can hold the machine quiet. A third lane -- H-ICPERF-5f038b / EXP-ICPERF-025a52, descent as a DAG, approval withheld by DEC-20260915-d8d413 -- may resume at any time without this session being told; nothing here touches its records either.

NO IDENTIFIER WAS MINTED BY THIS LANE. Every identifier used (BATCH-94168f, DEC-20260916-3c0cf5, H-ICPERF-afe62e, H-ICPERF-81de5c, H-ICPERF-f08b1e, EXP-ICPERF-2f2e40, EXP-ICPERF-61c136, EXP-ICPERF-42ef30, TASK-20260916-ec9948) was supplied pre-allocated and --check verified. The consequence, disclosed rather than worked around: the coordinator DESIGN act that produced this package has no queued card, because only the archival TASK identifier was allocated. Its output is owned by exactly one archival task, which is the binding requirement of AGENTS.md 'Durable research commits'. Executor and reviewer cards for the three contracts do not exist, so EXP-ICPERF-2f2e40 is APPROVED BUT NOT DISPATCHABLE.

TASK-20260916-ec9948 is a SNAPSHOT archive, following the precedent this goal set for a design package (TASK-20260915-6d72a0, which archived DEC-20260915-428a17 and eight sibling design records as a snapshot at f4f2dfa80). A LEDGER archive binds evidence records and the transitions they support; this batch composed no evidence record and moved no hypothesis on evidence. The ledger archive is owed later, after a producer has run and been independently reviewed, and will be a separate card. This queue file is committed in the same commit but is NOT hash-bound as an artifact_path, for the fixed-point reason BATCH-a33cda recorded against TASK-20260915-1942e2: a queue that records its own task's state transition cannot have its post-commit bytes declared before the commit that changes them.

inputs: ledger/goals/GOAL-ICPERF-e6b6a4/goal.yaml (READ ONLY; not staged, not edited)
constraints: Run alone. No concurrent worker commits into this worktree.
Stage only the declared paths. A scope-expanding commit is an evidence-integrity failure.
Before committing: fetch origin/main and MERGE it in (merge, never rebase); re-run tools/validate_ledger.py on the merged tree; record the base commit and merge outcome in the receipt.
A sync conflict inside any immutable record is resolved by a superseding record under a new identifier, never by editing either side.
Do not edit any of the nine records to make the archive tidier. They are frozen as written.
Mint no identifier. If a new record is needed, stop and request one.
After committing: push and open or refresh a PR against main naming the records.
Launch no trial; this is not a /run.

A post-commit verification of that receipt against Git, reported pass or fail
The pushed branch and an open or refreshed PR against main naming the records
The origin/main base commit checked and the merge outcome, in the receipt

Every declared path's sha256 in the receipt matches the committed tree.
The commit message names TASK-20260916-ec9948, DEC-20260916-3c0cf5, and the six H-/EXP- record ids.
The receipt records the origin/main base commit checked and the merge outcome.
The post-commit verifier ACCEPTS the receipt.
The branch is pushed and a PR against main is open or refreshed, naming the nine records.
tools/validate_ledger.py passes on the committed tree with no new errors attributable to these nine files.
handoff.return_format: Receipt path; commit_sha and parent_sha; verifier pass/fail with its exact message; origin/main base commit and merge outcome; PR url or number; validate_ledger result. Report any refusal or scope expansion rather than working around it.
